content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE INPUT_READ (L53-349; header comment L46: handle reading input.txt; the license banner mistakenly says 'FILE main.F' at L3). Provides typed keyword=value readers for input.txt with a generic interface READ_FOUR_TYPE_VALUES bound to READ_FLOAT/READ_STRING/READ_LOGICAL/READ_INTEGER (L65-70). Module state: FILE_EXIST, VAL_TYPE, VAL_READ (L61-63). All four readers share the same pattern: INQUIRE the input file and STOP (MPI_FINALIZE under PARALLEL) if missing (READ_INTEGER L83-93, READ_FLOAT L134-144, READ_LOGICAL L183-193, READ_STRING L227-237); call READ_VALUE to locate the keyword (L95, L146, L195, L240) and on ERR_IF_ONE==1 print 'DOES NOT EXIST. USE DEFAULT VALUE' and RETURN leaving the OUT argument unchanged (L96-103, L147-154, L196-203, L241-248); then CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE classifies the value string and mismatches are fatal STOPs for INTEGER (L106-116), float (L156-166) and string (L251-261), but only a warning for logical (L205-212, message 'SET FALSE EXCEPT FIRST LETTER IS T'); finally the value is converted: internal READ for integer (L118) and float (L168), first-character 'T' test for logical (L214-215), ADJUSTL(TRIM()) copy for string (L263). READ_VALUE (L271-308): opens the file on unit 10 (L283) and scans line by line (L285-302): strips comments from COM_CHAR='!' (PARAMETER L280) via index (L290-292), finds '=' (L295), compares the left side against MatchCharacter (L296-297) and returns the right side ADJUSTL'd (L298-299); on EOF sets ERR_IF_ONE=1 and closes the unit (L304-306). CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE (L310-347): classifies VREAD using the character set numbers="0123456789+-Ee. " (L319): a single character T or F is 'logical' (L324-329); any character outside the set makes it 'string' (L332-337); otherwise presence of '.' makes it 'float' else 'INTEGER' (L340-345).
entities: INTERFACE READ_FOUR_TYPE_VALUES (L65) with module procedures READ_FLOAT (L66), READ_STRING (L67), READ_LOGICAL (L68), READ_INTEGER (L69)
SUBROUTINE READ_INTEGER(INTEGER_VAL,InputFileName,MatchCharacter,ERR_IF_ONE) (L76); INTEGER_VAL INTENT(OUT) (L78); ERR_IF_ONE no INTENT (L81)
SUBROUTINE READ_FLOAT(FLOAT_VAL,...) (L126); FLOAT_VAL REAL(SP) INTENT(OUT) (L128); ERR_IF_ONE no INTENT (L132)
SUBROUTINE READ_LOGICAL(LOGICAL_VAL,...) (L175); LOGICAL_VAL INTENT(OUT) (L177); ERR_IF_ONE no INTENT (L181)
SUBROUTINE READ_STRING(STRING_VAL,...) (L220); STRING_VAL INTENT(OUT) (L222); ERR_IF_ONE INTENT(OUT) (L225)

SUBROUTINE READ_VALUE(FileName,MatchCharacter,VAL,ERR_IF_ONE) (L271); VAL CHARACTER(LEN=80) INTENT(OUT) (L275); locals TMPV,TMPV_NEXT,TEXT,TEXT_READ (L278), LOCATION,FRONT,TEXT_LENGTH,I (L279), COM_CHAR PARAMETER (L280)
SUBROUTINE CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE(VREAD,VTYPE) (L310); VTYPE INTENT(OUT) (L312); VREAD INTENT(IN) (L313); locals NUMBERS (L315), LOGICAL_VAL_READ (L316), DotLocation (L317), I (L318)

io.name: input file existence (INQUIRE, repeated in each reader)
'CAN NOT BE FOUND. STOP' / 'DOES NOT EXIST. USE DEFAULT VALUE' / type-mismatch messages (pattern repeated in each reader)

verbatim_spans.text: IF(MYID==0) WRITE(*,*) TRIM(MatchCharacter), ' IS NOT LOGICAL, SET FALSE EXCEPT FIRST LETTER IS T'

unresolved: Cross-line: READ_VALUE opens unit 10 (L283) but the success path RETURNs at L299 without CLOSE - only the EOF/failure path closes (L306). Each successful keyword lookup leaves unit 10 open; repeated OPEN on the same unit relies on Fortran reopen semantics.

Cross-line: on keyword-not-found (ERR_IF_ONE==1) the readers RETURN with the INTENT(OUT) argument never assigned (L102, L153, L202, L247); callers rely on assigning defaults after the call, but with INTENT(OUT) the variable is formally undefined during the call.

CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE classification edge cases: an all-digit string value (e.g. a numeric filename) classifies as INTEGER so READ_STRING STOPs (L252-261); exponent form without a dot (1E5) classifies as INTEGER so READ_FLOAT STOPs (L157-166); a single 'T'/'F' intended as a string classifies as logical. Whether input.txt conventions avoid these is external.
ERR_IF_ONE lacks an INTENT declaration in READ_INTEGER/READ_FLOAT/READ_LOGICAL (L81, L132, L181) but is INTENT(OUT) in READ_STRING (L225) - inconsistent interface across the generic set.
READ_VALUE lines whose '=' is absent give FRONT=0 and TMPV_NEXT=TEXT(1:-1) empty (L295-296); an empty MatchCharacter would match such lines - callers never pass empty keys, but the guard is absent.
Under PARALLEL, only rank 0 prints diagnostics but ALL ranks call MPI_FINALIZE and STOP on missing file (L86-88); non-collective STOP after MPI_FINALIZE ordering is implementation-dependent.
The license banner says 'FILE main.F' (L3) although this file is mod_input.F.
